title: AICA
description: All items collection advancements. 全物品收集进度。
body:
All Item Collection Advancement (AICA) is a datapack for Minecraft 1.19 that adds advancements for all obtainable items in survival mode in 1.19, allowing players to easily view their obtained and unobtained items. Welcome to issue. 
 
Explanation: 
 
1. The type of item is based on the namespace id, and each id is counted as one item. Items described in the same wiki article in the minecraft wiki are counted as one genus and share a advancement. 
 
2. The classification of items is divided into classes, orders, families, genera, and species. Each order opens a advancement page, and the advancement can only be lit when all items under the item are collected. Any item under the order and family can be collected to light up the advancement. The collection of all items is a separate advancement page, which breaks down the secondary progress down to the order. Each advancement on this page requires full collection to be lit. 
 
3. This datapack fit 1.19 and does not include items added in 1.20 and later versions, but it can still be used. To use it in versions 1.18 and below, delete all old non-existent item advancements (this may be a bit cumbersome). 
 
4. It is recommended to use it together with the AdvancementInfo mod to facilitate viewing the unfinished parts of the advancement and make the page larger and more comfortable. 


全物品收集进度（AICA）是一个适用于Minecraft1.19的数据包，为1.19中的全部生存模式可获得物品添加了一个进度，可以让玩家方便地查看自己已获得和未获得的物品。欢迎issue。

说明：

1.物品种类以命名空间id为准，每个id算作一种物品。在minecraft wiki中同一篇wiki介绍的物品算作一属，共享一个进度。

2.物品分类为纲、目、科、属、种。每个目开一个进度页，该页下每个属的物品全部收集时才可点亮进度，目和科下任一物品收集即可点亮进度。全物品收集是单独进度页，向下拆分次级进度到目，该页每个进度都要求全收集方可点亮。

3.该数据包适用于1.19，不包含1.20及以后新添加的物品，但仍可使用。若要在1.18及以下版本使用，请删除所有旧版不存在的物品进度（这可能有些麻烦）。

4.建议与AdvancementInfo模组一起使用，方便查看进度中未完成的部分，且使页面更大更舒适。
